title: Nonadaptive Function Tester
statement: Let the domain and codomain be types and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. A nonadaptive function tester consists of a finite seed space with a probability distribution, a rule that assigns to each seed and each of the $r$ transcript positions either a domain element to query or no query, and a deterministic rule that decides acceptance from the seed and the resulting partial transcript of codomain values.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution on the seed space
For each seed and position, the query is either a domain element or absent
A deterministic acceptance predicate on the seed and partial transcript
